newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts to seek upside, eye 110-10 high.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts to seek upside, eye 110-10 high.

text.p: June gilt futures traded on LIFFE will maintain the positive tone from Tuesday and are set to climb towards 110-10 on Wednesday, technical analysts said.

"We have broken the small downtrend that we had and potentially we looking for a re-test of the high we saw on April 17 at 110-10," said Norman Beauchamp, head of derivatives at Cooperative Bank in London.

Fundamentals pushed gilts higher on Tuesday when a weaker-than-expected U.S. empolyment cost index was released and Beauchamp said the positive mood was likely to continue ahead of the U.S. non-farm payrolls data on Friday.

"External factors are much more important now," said Beauchamp. "The problems if Labour do get in will rear their head a little bit further down the line...we will have to see what their first move is."
Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London also said gilts were likely to continue their retracement.
"June futures set 109-30/110-00 as a key area for short-term trends. A break higher targets 110-07 retracement and possibly 110-28," they said in a research note.
A 38.2 percent Fibonacci retracement of the decline from 113-19 in Februray to 108-05 comes in at 110-07.
They said support was at 109-18 and 109-12, from the previous downtrends while a structural channel offered a further prop at 108-24.
At the short end June short sterling futures were at 93.39, up one basis point on the day.
"The downtrend at 93.42 provides key short-term resistance; a break is likely to turn indicators positive, targeting retracement to 93.46 and 93.50," Deutsche analysts said.
